description: A field with any of these names refuses the whole request, at any depth, and its value is never echoed in the error. Three groups: raw genetic data this system does not interpret, identifiable or clinical text it has no reason to hold, and answers only the server may determine.
title: Request field names this API refuses (WP-16)

x-pgx-prohibited-fields.active_pointer_generation: pointer state is observed, never asserted
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.activity_score: an activity score is derived from a genotype translation this system does not do
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.actor: the actor is taken from the authenticated principal, never from the request
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.allele: allele data requires a reviewed translation to a phenotype
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.alleles: allele data requires a reviewed translation to a phenotype
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.clinical_notes: clinical notes must not influence a calculation
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.coverage_reason_codes: coverage reasons are calculated, never supplied

x-pgx-prohibited-fields.date_of_birth: a date of birth is identifiable data
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.diplotype: a diplotype requires a reviewed allele-function translation this system does not perform
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.dob: a date of birth is identifiable data
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.dosage: this system calculates no dosage and accepts none
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.dose: this system calculates no dose and accepts none

x-pgx-prohibited-fields.indication: an indication is a clinical judgement, not an input
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.input_hash: hashes are computed from what was actually asked
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.mrn: a medical record number is identifiable data
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.narrative: free narrative must not influence a calculation
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.notes: free notes must not influence a calculation
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.output_hash: hashes are computed from what was actually calculated
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.patient_id: a patient identifier is identifiable data with no calculation role here
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.patient_name: identifiable data has no calculation role
x-pgx-prohibited-fields.patient_narrative: free clinical narrative must not influence a calculation
